records.name: West Philadelphia Tutoring Project (WPTP)
records.summary: Penn students tutor local K-12 students one on one for free through Civic House. Sessions run in the fall and spring, in person or online.
records.what_you_do: Tutors meet a student each week on schoolwork, test prep, or enrichment, and take part in learning about social justice. Tutors apply each semester.

schedule.text: Free weekly one on one tutoring sessions Sunday through Thursday in the fall and spring, virtual or in person

first_step.how: Apply as a tutor in the Fall 2026 application round. The listing gives October 20, 2026 as the last day of rolling applications.
first_step.basis: Tutors apply before they are matched with a student, so the way in needs an application.

records.notes: Directory dates: September 11, 2026 (tutor application deadline) and October 20, 2026 (last day of rolling applications). The club site lists Spring 2026 tutor and tutee applications and no dated posts. The directory says it is not accepting members right now, so the tutor application is the way in. Tutees are K-12 students, not members, and are not recorded as members.

records.name: West Philly Swingers
records.summary: Penn's swing dance troupe, which dances Lindy Hop and West Coast Swing. It is part social group and part stage group, and dancers at any level can audition.
records.what_you_do: Members dance socially, learn at beginner lessons, and perform. Auditions open each semester and start with a beginner lesson and a chance to meet current members.

schedule.text: Auditions held every semester; Fall 2026 audition dates to be announced

first_step.how: Watch for the semester audition announcement and sign up. Auditions start with a beginner lesson, so no dance experience is needed.
first_step.basis: An audition is required to join, but it begins with a beginner lesson and needs no experience.

records.notes: The directory says the club is not accepting members right now but lists auditions coming up, with Fall 2026 audition dates still to be released. The club's own site returned only a blank page, so it was not used. No dated item with a month was found, so the status is probably_active.

records.name: Wharton AI & Analytics Club (WAIAC)
records.summary: A hub for Wharton students who want to learn, build, and talk about AI, data science, and business analytics. Members join workshops, hackathons, speaker events, and small group dinners.
records.what_you_do: Sign up through the club page, then take part in hands-on workshops, build sprints on real company briefs, and talks with industry guests.

schedule.text: Workshops, hackathons, speaker events, and dinners listed on the club's events feed

first_step.how: Use the Join the Club button on the club page to sign up. The directory says an application is required, so check the sign-up page for the steps.
first_step.basis: The directory lists an application, while the club site says no prior knowledge is needed, so the way in is not fully clear.

records.notes: The directory email is hidden. The club site copyright year (2026) is not counted as evidence, and no dated posts were found, so the status is probably_active. records.name: Wharton Asia Exchange
records.summary: A pre-professional group for Penn undergraduates interested in business in Asia. It offers business skills training, speaker events, and small groups for mentoring and socials.
records.what_you_do: Join general body events, take part in socials and speaker programs, and sign up for a smaller group within the club. Apply through Penn Clubs to become a member.

schedule.text: Community socials, speaker events, and more than 30 events a year according to the club site

first_step.how: Apply through the Penn Clubs page, then sign up for general body events to meet members before you apply.
first_step.basis: Non-members can sign up for general body events, so students can see the club before applying.

records.notes: The directory says the club is not accepting members right now and lists a September 18 application deadline with no year. The newest dated item on the club site is a 2020 award, and a 2024 image file name is not counted. The status is probably_active because the site describes ongoing events without dates. The directory email is hidden, so it was not recorded.

records.name: Wharton Asian American Association of MBAs (WAAAM)
records.summary: A community for Wharton MBA students who want to celebrate Asian American and Pacific Islander identities while building careers and friendships. Students of any background and allies are welcome.
records.what_you_do: Join social events, identity focused panels and workshops, career support, and mentoring. Members sign up through the club's CampusGroups page.

schedule.text: Small dinners, hobby groups, panels, and large social events; the club lists registration for a Fall 2026 event

first_step.how: Join through the club's CampusGroups page. The club lists registration for a Fall 2026 event on its website.
first_step.basis: The directory lists an application as required, so membership goes through the club's sign-up first.

records.name: Wharton International Business and Economics Club (WIBEC)
records.summary: An undergraduate club for students interested in economics, global affairs, and international business. It hosts industry conversations, current events analysis, and workshops.

records.name: Wharton Investment & Trading Group (WITG)
records.summary: Penn's undergraduate investing and finance organization, which trains students for careers in investing and finance. Members join investment teams, a beginner program called the Accelerator, or the general membership.
records.what_you_do: Join a student investment team to research stocks and build models, or start in the Accelerator with no prior experience. Attend Sunday meetings, speaker events, and stock pitch contests.

schedule.text: Weekly investment team meetings and general body meetings on Sundays

first_step.how: Join the listserv through the contact page, or follow the Fall 2026 join link on the club site.
first_step.basis: The Accelerator is for underclassmen with no prior experience, and anyone can join the listserv.

records.notes: The directory says the club is not accepting members right now. The club site has Fall 2026 join links and award years from 2025 to 2026, but no dated posts and no month, so the status is probably_active. The site describes weekly meetings on Sundays.

records.name: Wharton Korea Undergraduate Business Society (W-KUBS)
records.summary: A Wharton recognized student group that builds a Korea focused business community at Penn and beyond. Its committees cover consulting, finance recruiting prep, marketing, and career treks, with monthly socials.
records.what_you_do: Join a committee, go to monthly socials, and take part in career and recruiting programs. The club also runs a case competition for Korean high school students.

schedule.text: Monthly socials and committee programs through the year; Fall 2026 applications open

first_step.basis: Membership is by application, so students apply before joining committees.

records.name: Wharton Marketing Club
records.summary: A Wharton group that connects students, alumni, faculty, and recruiters around marketing. It offers education, events, and career connections for people who want to work in marketing.
records.what_you_do: Attend marketing events and programs and meet alumni and recruiters. Apply to join through the club site.

first_step.how: Apply through the join page on the club site, since the directory says an application is required.
first_step.basis: Membership needs an application before you see the club in full.

The site has an annual events page with no visible dates, so the status is probably_active from a working site with no dated items. Advisor and officer emails were left out. This group and MUSE (also in this batch) are both Wharton marketing groups; check for overlap.

records.name: Wharton Marketing Undergraduate Student Establishment (MUSE)
records.summary: The student run marketing group at Wharton and Penn, and also the American Marketing Association chapter at Penn. Members take on client consulting projects, run campus marketing conferences, and join networking events with industry guests.
records.what_you_do: Join general body meetings, sign up for a committee such as consulting, digital, or events, and help with client projects and conferences.

schedule.text: Monthly general body meetings. The club lists Fall 2026 committee recruiting as open.

first_step.how: Sign up for general body events through the club's listserv. Committee applications are part of fall recruiting.
first_step.basis: All Penn undergraduates can sign up for general body events and programs, so students can see the club before applying to a committee.

records.notes: The directory's structured listing says not accepting members, but its involvement text says committees recruit for Fall 2026, so the listing contradicts itself. The club site lists a 2026 AMA case competition result (third place) with no month, so the status is probably_active. Co-president names and emails were left out.

notes: All 20 Penn clubs in this batch were read from the pennclubs.com public API. Each club's own website was fetched once where the entry linked one (17 fetches). Retries: the Wellness site redirected once to its wordpress address and that was followed; the WIBEC site failed with a connection reset on two attempts and was not retried further. Blank or unrelated pages: the West Philly Swingers site, the Wharton Hedge Fund Club site and the Wharton Muslims in Business group page returned no usable content. No rate limiting was seen. Records held back (no summary, categories or interests, status unknown) because the directory entry is marked INACTIVE or conflicts with its active flag: Wellness Student Coalition, West Philadelphia Sanctuary, WAAG, WASA, Alumni Connections Council, Wharton Crew Team, Wharton Energy Conference, Wharton Graduate Association, Wharton Muslims in Business. Four of these (Wellness, Energy Conference, WAAG, Sanctuary) have current-looking evidence on their own sites or in the directory text, so the orchestrator should decide whether to promote them. Hedge Fund Club is marked dormant on 2021 evidence only. WIBEC is published with status unknown. Personal names, phone numbers and personal emails were left out, including officer and advisor contacts. Searches used: 0.
